children: Myseum.AI launched a partnership with Fujifilm to offer integrated print-on-demand products to Picture Party users, creating a new revenue stream.
Partnered with FUJIFILM North America to enable print-on-demand within Picture Party, announced Sept. 16, 2026.
Service launching later this month will let users order prints and customizable products (mugs, canvas, totes, puzzles, etc.).
Full integration in-app enables selection, product choice, and ordering without leaving Picture Party, improving user flow.
High-resolution, privacy-first platform preserves image quality—supports premium prints and positions a new revenue opportunity.

title: Myseum.AI partners with Fujifilm to add print-on-demand to Picture Party
